read.thesis: Spend growth hit a three-year high (10% reported, 9% FX-adj) and revenue grew 11%, but management reaffirmed 9-10% revenue and $17.30-17.90 EPS, reinvesting the upside in marketing and technology.

triggers.label: Spend growth 10% reported, highest in 3 years
triggers.quote: this is the highest quarterly growth in three years

triggers.label: Revenue guide held at 9-10% despite 11% print
triggers.quote: we are reaffirming our full‑year 2026 guidance of 9% to 10% annual revenue growth

triggers.label: Platinum fee refresh lifting Card fees 16%
triggers.quote: Net Card fees continue to be our fastest‑growing line, up 16% FX‑adjusted

red_flags.label: Reserve release flattered provision
red_flags.quote: Overall provision expense of $1.3 billion included a reserve release of $24 million.

red_flags.label: Airline refund spike late March-April
red_flags.quote: we definitely saw a spike in customer refunds

evasions.quote: you can make your own judgment on that
